narr: An upper level low pressure system originated over the Dakotas before pivoting and becoming negatively tilted during the early morning hours on May 24, 2024. An associated surface cold front pushed through the Missouri Ozarks during the afternoon, bringing scattered thunderstorms producing hail between quarter and hen egg size as well as isolated flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding was reported at the Locust Street and Soccer Field Road low water crossing in Dixon. Water was also over the roadway at Cottonwood Drive in Dixon.
